key_decisions.decision: Retain the ark as the immediate object of seeking without erasing the wider religious implication.
Unfold the divine titles while retaining the ark’s association with the Name.
Keep the named location and the physical reason for reaching out.
Preserve the narrated cause, divine agency, and death without softening them.
Keep David’s anger and the repeated breaking-out language behind the name.
